subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in media batching for LINE and similar channels now, and should that live as channel-owned plugin behavior or a shared SDK/gateway batching seam?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent product choice affects latency, config surface, reply-token handling, and whether this belongs in individual channel plugins or a shared channel contract.

options.title: Channel-owned opt-in batching
options.body: Add a LINE plugin media batching delay with scoped keys and focused tests, while leaving Telegram and WhatsApp on their existing channel-specific trackers.

options.title: Design shared media-batch seam first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define a reusable SDK/gateway contract for media batching across several channels.

options.title: Defer and document current behavior
options.body: Keep only native channel grouping like Telegram albums and document that LINE-style rapid media events dispatch separately.

recommendation.title: Channel-owned opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a LINE plugin media batching delay with scoped keys and focused tests, while leaving Telegram and WhatsApp on their existing channel-specific trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a cross-channel/config product boundary decision, and the history shows this handle on the shared inbound debounce policy and adjacent channel media handling.
